boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 56 packs a tight grid with a purple '3' block at the top, red and blue blocks filling the upper rows, and yellow/green blocks in the middle. The chokepoint is the purple '3' — it blocks the upper section. Clear the bottom first, then work the middle yellow and green blocks out, and finish with the numbered blocks at the top.
landmarks: Block Out Level 56 packs a tight grid with a purple '3' block at the top, red and blue blocks filling the upper rows, and yellow/green blocks in the middle.
The chokepoint is the purple '3' — it blocks the upper section.
Clear the bottom first, then work the middle yellow and green blocks out, and finish with the numbered blocks at the top.

quickTips: The purple '3' block at the top is a multi-pass piece — clear the blocks below it first so it has room to slide.
Clear the bottom rows first to create sliding space for the upper numbered blocks.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the red and pink blocks at the bottom toward the right exit to open the base.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Shift the green blocks on the left out through the left exit to open the lower-left area.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Move the yellow blocks in the center through the left exit now that the path is clear.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Begin clearing the blue blocks in the middle through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Tackle the purple '3' block at the top — it needs three exits to fully clear.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the remaining red and blue blocks on the right through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with any remaining blocks trapped in the corners.

failurePoints: Trying to clear the purple '3' block before the blocks below it — it needs room to slide and exit multiple times.
Clearing the top before the bottom, which leaves the lower blocks trapped with no sliding room.
